events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. Sign up goes live Thursday, October 1 at 7 pm.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social is at Oskar Blues Brewery [ 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712 ]. Sign up goes live Sunday, November 1 at 7 pm.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social is at Big Pillow Brewing [ 25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231 ]. Sign up goes live Tuesday, December 1 at 7 pm.
